system.description:
Acquired with CR11 or higher. Deal [(SRx2)D + (Attack Power)] physical damage to the target. If there are no other enemies in the same square as you except the target, increase the damage by +[STR mod].

A special skill that drives in a series of fire-like momentum while moving in a circle to constantly go around the enemy's blind spots. Its ferocious attack becomes a chariot of fire that drags the enemy to death.
